occurrenceRemarks: Collected for the project “Origin and Evolution of the Chihuahuan Desert Gypsum Endemic Flora”

recordedBy: Michael J. Moore|Hilda Flores Olvera|Helga Ochoterena Booth|Norm Douglas
locality: Along MEX 53 at km 101.
name: Nama stenophylla A.Gray
habitat: In gypsum outcrops. A number of gypsum endemic taxa present at this site including Acleisanthes, Tiquilia, Nama, etc.  Conditions dry, although better close to the road.
occurrenceRemarks: Collected for the project “Origin and Evolution of the Chihuahuan Desert Gypsum Endemic Flora”

recordedBy: Michael J. Moore|Hilda Flores Olvera|Helga Ochoterena Booth|Norm Douglas
locality: A gypsum outcrop ca. 10-15 km by gravel road  W of MEX 53.
name: Nama stenophylla A.Gray
habitat: In small area of gypsum hills (ca. 2 km by 2 km) at foot of limestone hills. This area is activelly mined for gypsum. Diverse gypsum endemic assemblage dominated by Agave, Fouquieria, Tiquilia mexicana, Haploesthes greggii, Nerisyrenia, Hedyotis, with numerous other taxa present including Nama cf. stenophyllum, Dicranocarpus, Acleisanthes purpusiana and Drymaria. Conditions reasonable to good.
occurrenceRemarks: Collected for the project “Origin and Evolution of the Chihuahuan Desert Gypsum Endemic Flora”
identificationRemarks: Det. given as: Nama cf. stenophyllum.

name: Nama stenophylla A.Gray
habitat: Gypsum dunes and flats. Gypsum endemic flora along with Prosopis, Ephedra, etc. Conditions very dry.
occurrenceRemarks: Collected for the project “Origin and Evolution of the Chihuahuan Desert Gypsum Endemic Flora”.

name: Nama stenophylla A.Gray

recordedBy: Michael J. Moore|Hilda Flores Olvera|Helga Ochoterena Booth|Norm Douglas
locality: At the base of a limestone-capped mesa ca 3 km NNE of Ejido Carricitos.
name: Nama stenophylla A.Gray
habitat: In small gypsum area (ca 2 km by 1 km) resulting from evaporite diapir eruption.  An extremely interesting gypsum endemic flora present, dominated by species of Haploësthes, Nerisyrenia, Tiquilia, Dicranocarpus, Fouquieria, Agave, Xanthisma, etc.  A diverse set of cacti present, as well as Acleisanthes, Nama, and Drymaria.  Conditions reasonable to good on gypsum, despite relatively dry conditions elsewhere.
